title: Malicious code in @mrnima/technology_news_info (npm)
description: The npm package @mrnima/technology_news_info contains malicious code that can fully compromise any computer on which it is installed or running. The presence of this package indicates a severe security breach, as attackers may gain full control of the affected system. Immediate removal of the package is recommended, but due to potential persistent malicious software, complete remediation may require additional steps. All secrets and keys stored on the compromised computer should be rotated from a different, secure machine to prevent further unauthorized access.
